name: Mean transcoding FPS achieved in the last 5 minutes
query: |> range(start: -5m)  |>filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "jellyfin-qos")  |>group(columns: ["_field"], mode: "by")  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Transcoding FPS")  |> mean()

name: Mean (apparent) power consumption in the last hour
query: |> range(start: -1h)  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "delock-energy")  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Machine"] == "energy/anemone/SENSOR")  |> group(columns: ["_field"], mode: "by")  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Apparent power")  |> mean()
